warnings.label: Usk Estuary
warnings.message: There is a risk of flooding as a result of the combination of the high tides and weather conditions for Tuesday evenings high tide. Flooding of low-lying land and roads is expected. Be careful on coastal footpaths, roads, low lying land, close to the estuary. We will continue to monitor the situation.
